name: Oxygenerator
source:
You are captain Orson, the captain of the Oxygenerator. When the pressure seems high on the Oxygen gauges, a group decide to check it out. What happens next will change the future of mankind.

[From [url=https://pixelcatofficial.itch.io/oxygenerator]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是“制氧者号”的船长奥森。当氧气表显示压力似乎过高时，一行人决定前去检查。接下来发生的事，将改变人类的未来。

[摘自[url=https://pixelcatofficial.itch.io/oxygenerator]itch.io[/url]]
